# Fiery svinstew

Type: Food | Internal ID: FierySvinstew | Source: Cauldron | Usage: Eating | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Asksvin tail x1, Vineberry cluster x2, Smoke puff x1 | Max Health: 95 | Max Stamina: 32 | Duration: 25m | Healing: 6 hp/tick

# Introduction

Fiery svinstew is an Ashlands-tier food.

## Recipe

Fiery svinstew can be crafted at a level 5 Cauldron with:
• 1 Asksvin tail
• 2 Vineberry cluster
• 1 Smoke puff

## Notes

Fiery svinstew provides the third highest health gain in the game, behind Mashed meat and Piquant pie.
